Adds a new CSV file with your custom IPS signature rules.

get.description: Retrieves the list of advanced threat categories (predefined and custom) against which your network traffic can be monitored and protected using the IPS Control policy. To learn more, see About Threat Categories.

id.description: System-generated identifier for the custom IPS signature rule

ruleText.description: Zscaler supported custom IPS signature rule text based on the Snort-like syntax. To learn more, see Specifications & Limitations for Custom IPS Signature Rules.

description.description: Additional information about the custom signature rule

category.description: The threat category that is assigned to the custom signature rule

enabled.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether the custom signature rule is enabled and is ready to be used in IPS Control rules via the assigned threat category

deleted.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether the custom signature rule is deleted

status.description: Status of the file import process

totalRecordsAdded.description: Total records added when the import process is COMPLETE, CANCELLED or ERRORED

totalRecordsDeleted.description: Total records deleted when the import process is COMPLETE, CANCELLED or ERRORED

totalRecordsUpdated.description: Total records updated when the import process is COMPLETE, CANCELLED, or ERRORED

failedRecords.description: List of failed records during the import process

processedRecords.description: Total records processed when the import process is COMPLETE, CANCELLED, or ERRORED

totalRecordsInImport.description: Total records processed from the CSV file

errors.description: Errors encountered during the import process

status.description: The validation status of the custom IPS signature rule text

errPosition.description: The position in the rule text where the error occured

errMsg.description: The error message for the rule text corresponding to the error position

errParameter.description: The rule text parameter that causes an error

idList.description: The list of IDs used by certain validations. This is an optional field.

SMMsgStatusInfo.description: Error message information that is returned when an invalid pattern is identified

accessControl.description: The admin’s access privilege to this rule based on the assigned role

id.description: Unique identifier generated for the rule

name.description: The name of the IPS Control rule

order.description: Policy rules are evaluated in ascending numerical order (Rule 1 before Rule 2, and so on), and this field specifies the order of execution for the rule.

rank.description: The admin rank specified for the rule based on your assigned admin rank. Admin rank determines the rule order that can be specified for the rule. Admin rank can be configured if it is enabled in the Advanced Settings. To learn more, see About Admin Rank.

locations.description: The locations to which the rule applies

locationGroups.description: The location groups to which the rule applies

departments.description: The departments to which the rule applies

groups.description: The user groups to which the rule applies

users.description: The users to which the rule applies

timeWindows.description: The time intervals during which the rule applies

action.description: The action configured for the rule that must take place if the traffic matches the rule criteria, such as allowing or blocking the traffic or bypassing the rule.

capturePCAP.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not

state.description: The state of the rule indicating whether it is enabled or disabled

lastModifiedTime.description: The timestamp when the rule was last modified

lastModifiedBy.description: The admin who last modified the rule

srcIps.description: Source IP addresses or FQDNs to which the rule applies. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific source IP address. Each IP entry can be a single IP address, CIDR (e.g., 10.10.33.0/24), or an IP range (e.g., 10.10.33.1-10.10.33.10).

srcIpGroups.description: Source IP address groups for which the rule is applicable. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific source IP address group.

srcIpv6Groups.description:
Source IPv6 address groups for which the rule is applicable. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific source IPv6 address group.

Note: User-defined groups for IPv6 addresses are currently not supported.

destAddresses.description: Destination IP addresses or FQDNs to which the rule applies. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific destination IP address. Each IP entry can be a single IP address, CIDR (e.g., 10.10.33.0/24), or an IP range (e.g., 10.10.33.1-10.10.33.10).

destIpCategories.description: Destination IP categories to which the rule applies. If not set, the rule is not restricted to specific categories.

resCategories.description: URL categories associated with resolved IP addresses to which the rule applies. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific URL category.

destCountries.description: Destination countries for which the rule is applicable. If not set, the rule is not restricted to specific destination countries.

sourceCountries.description: The countries of origin of traffic for which the rule is applicable. If not set, the rule is not restricted to specific source countries.

destIpGroups.description: Destination IP address groups for which the rule is applicable. If not set, the rule is not restricted to specific destination IPv6 address groups.

destIpv6Groups.description:
Destination IPv6 address groups for which the rule is applicable. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific source IPv6 address group.

Note :User-defined groups for IPv6 addresses are currently not supported.

nwServices.description: Network services to which the rule applies

nwServiceGroups.description: Network service groups to which the rule applies

threatCategories.description: Advanced threat categories to which the rule applies

devices.description: Devices to which the rule applies. This field is applicable for devices that are managed using Zscaler Client Connector. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

deviceGroups.description: Device groups to which the rule applies. This field is applicable for devices that are managed using Zscaler Client Connector. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

labels.description: The label associated with the rule

zpaAppSegments.description: The ZPA application segments to which the rule applies

enableFullLogging.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether full logging is enabled. A true value indicates that full logging is enabled, whereas a false value indicates that aggregate logging is enabled.

predefined.description: A Boolean field that indicates that the rule is predefined by using a true value

defaultRule.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether the rule is the Default Cloud IPS Rule or not

FirewallIpsRule.description: IPS Control policy rule configuration. To learn about rule configuration details, see Configuring the IPS Control Policy.

id.description: System-generated unique identifier for the IPS threat category

backEndName.description: IPS threat category name that appears in the user interface in the ZIA Admin Portal

description.description: Description for the IPS threat category

deleted.description: Indicates whether the IPS threat category has been deleted

predefined.description: A true value indicates that the IPS threat category is predefined, whereas a false value indicates that it is user-defined.

ipsSignatureRulesCount.description: The number of IPS Control policy rules currently using this threat category as rule criteria

id.description: A unique identifier for an entity

name.description: The configured name of the entity

externalId.description: An external identifier used for an entity that is managed outside of ZIA. Examples include zpaServerGroup and zpaAppSegments. This field is not applicable to ZIA-managed entities.

EntityReference.description: This is an immutable reference to an entity that mainly consists of ID and name

id.description: A unique identifier assigned to the Application Segment

name.description: The name of the Application Segment

externalId.description: Indicates the external ID. Applicable only when this reference is of an external entity.

zpaTenantId.description: ID of the ZPA tenant where the Application Segment is configured
